segments.text: Phil has reconnected with his old high school girlfriend, Denise, on Facebook. He plans to meet her for a drink, but Claire immediately becomes suspicious. Phil insists that they’re only friends and invites Denise to the house instead, hoping to prove that Claire is overreacting.

segments.text: At first, Denise seems friendly, and Claire starts to think she was wrong. But as soon as Claire leaves the room, Denise begins touching Phil, flirting with him, and even gives him a key to her hotel room.
